attested.hardware: Perlmutter CPU nodes (AMD EPYC 7763, 128 workers per node): the level-3 census in four interactive allocations on 2026-10-23 (jobs 60160192, 60160573, 60170484, 60171488; about 12 node-hours for the kernel-2 pass, 4,096 chunks, 442,623,432 prefixes, 54,157,309,763 candidates decided modulo two primes), the level-5 kappa = 0 lifts (128 chunks, minutes) and the kappa = 1 family brute force (35 bases x 243 ranges, about 2 node-hours); the other stages on an Apple silicon laptop
attested.note: The stored outputs are the census (4,096 chunks of 3 or 4 pivot pairs: pairs, covers, the prefixes skipped because the third letter lies in span(t, u, a) modulo P1, counters), the level-5 kappa = 0 lifts (128 chunks over the 2,574 bases of results/b4_reps_v2.json) and the kappa = 1 family brute force (35 files, one per base of results/b4_reps_v1.json, each with its 243 first-option ranges). The certificate verifies every stored output by hash and recomputes in full: the letters, the symmetry group and the pivot pairs, the rank-4 census and its closure (the 2,160 four-term decompositions of |S>^3), the premises chi(S^3) >= 4 and chi(S^5) >= 5 exactly (so a decomposition with four or fewer terms fails the run), Theorem F.3 exactly (no five-term decomposition of |S>^5 with a product term, over the three representatives of |S>^4 and the complete four-qutrit letter table), the closure of the stored covers (2,013,120 in 154 orbits) with every representative confirmed over Z[omega], the P2 recheck of every one-prime skip, every lift from level 3 to level 4, the 9,936 four-term decompositions of |S>^4, the 756 product-pattern completions, the span scan of all 7,439,040 four-qutrit letters and the assembly of the 2,609 level-4 bases (compared with the stored lists, the 2,574 independent ones confirmed exactly), and checks that the stored level-5 results cover every base with nothing found. Whole work units re-run from the seed ('recomputed' = 3): one census chunk of three pivot pairs with stored covers re-enumerated from scratch with fresh functionals and compared cover for cover and skip for skip, and two kappa = 0 lift chunks (about 40 bases) re-lifted; on top of these, three 100-prefix slices (two around stored covers), 120 further bases and 4 of the 8,505 family ranges are recomputed. Every modular decision in the work is exact by Hadamard's bound (minors of norm at most 6^6 against P of order 2e9). Completeness rests on the stored outputs and on the committed code (research/s5_rank5), which regenerates any chunk, lift chunk or family range (census.py run 5 OUT K 4096; lift45.py OUT K 128 --kappa0-only; lift45_fam.py OUT B K 243).

provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: recursive slice-and-lift over non-minimal covers: every five-term decomposition of |S>^5 is all full, hence a lift of a five-term decomposition of |S>^4 with nonzero coefficients; these are lifts of five-covers of |S>^3 (exact census) or completions of its four-term decompositions; no level-4 base lifts

compute.hardware: Perlmutter CPU nodes (AMD EPYC 7763) for the census (two passes: kernel 1 abandoned after 1,491 chunks when its one-prime dependency screen was replaced by the two-prime decision, kernel 2 complete), the level-5 lifts and the family brute force; Apple silicon laptop (loaded, load average 70 to 100) for the controls and the other stages

notes: Projection monotonicity from bounds/S-m5-lower-6.json: a decomposition of |S>^7 with r terms gives one of |S>^5 with at most r terms by fixing 2 qutrit(s) to |1>, so chi(S^7) >= chi(S^5) >= 6. Strict improvement of bounds/S-m7-lower-5.json.
